exposure: women's position within the household (socio-economic dependence, maternal health decision making, social mobility)
cohort: The study included 503 ever-married women of reproductive age (15-49 years) who had childbirth in the last twelve months or were pregnant (more than 6 months) at the time of the interview.
finding: Inferior status of women, characterized by restricted mobility, limited decision-making power, and experience of intimate partner violence, were found to be significant contributing factors to home delivery.
cross-section timing: Participants included women who had childbirth in the last twelve months or were pregnant (more than 6 months) at the time of the interview.
